Meet Our Doctors at Missouri Animal Cancer Care
in Wentzville
Appointment Request
Dedicated to Compassion, Connection, and Care
Our team consists of board-certified oncologists,
registered
veterinary technicians, and advanced support
staff. We are
united by a shared purpose: to help pets and their families navigate cancer with comfort, understanding, and hope. Each member of our staff brings exceptional training, gentle hands, and a heartfelt commitment to supporting quality of life.
We’re proud to serve the Greater St. Louis area from our Wentzville location, offering a quieter, more personal approach to veterinary oncology. Our team understands that every patient’s story is unique — and every day is a chance to make that story brighter.
A Team You
Can Trust
Every professional at
Missouri Animal Cancer Care
is deeply invested in our mission of providing thoughtful, informed, and compassionate cancer care.
Together, we’re dedicated to giving families clarity, confidence, and peace of mind throughout their pet’s treatment journey.
S. Bevin Rippy, DVM, DACVIM (Oncology)
Medical Director
Dr. Rippy is a board-certified medical oncologist with a special interest in feline oncology and canine urothelial carcinoma. She graduated from veterinary school at UC Davis in 2012 and completed internships at VCA SFVS in San Francisco, the University of Missouri Veterinary Health Center in Columbia, and The Ohio State University Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital in Columbus.
She returned to Missouri to complete her residency in medical oncology in 2018. Dr. Rippy has worked in both private practice and academia and currently serves as an adjunct professor at the University of Missouri. She enjoys traveling with her husband and curling up with her cats, a cup of tea, and a good book.
Julie Wentz, DVM
